hero.p: Nắng Factory designs and installs solar systems for metal roofs, concrete roofs and factory roofs, sized to fit your roof and your electricity bill.

notes.ton: Metal roof: rails clamp onto the corrugation, panels sit close to the roof, very few holes.
notes.be: Concrete roof: tilted racks on a flat roof, with the angle set to catch more sun.
notes.xn: Factory roof: large panel arrays on a wide roof, cutting power cost during production hours.

hero.hint: Drag across the picture or use the arrow keys to move the sun; the light on the roof changes with it.

about.h: We turn rooftops into small power plants
about.p: Nắng Factory designs green solar systems for factory roofs, metal roofs and home concrete roofs. Every system is sized from the customer's own roof and electricity bill.

values.b: Uses the sunshine you already have, cutting grid power and emissions.
One drawing per roof, never a shared template.
With you from survey to maintenance after installation.

products.h: Core products: solar for every kind of roof

items.t: Metal roofs for homes and small workshops
items.b: Rails clamp straight onto the corrugation, keeping drilling to a minimum.
Tilted frames on a flat roof so the angle can be tuned to the sun.
High-capacity systems designed to cut electricity cost in production hours.

est.h: How much could your electricity bill drop?
est.note: Indicative estimate: average tariff 2,300 VND/kWh, a 550 W panel takes about 2.6 m² including spacing, and monthly output is an illustrative figure per region. Actual results depend on roof direction, shading and your tariff. Nắng Factory will survey your roof and give exact numbers.

steps.b: We measure size, orientation and shading, and check the structure.
Panel layout drawing, expected output and a transparent quote.
Clean, safe work with the electrical connection completed.
We hand over and show you how to track output on your phone.

dist.p: Our North, Central and South distributor network lets Nắng Factory survey and install close to your site.
dist.label: List of distributors in three regions

items.b: Capacity is sized to your roof and usage, never more than you need.
Every item in the quote has a reason, and you can ask about it.
Panels, inverters and mounting have certificates, listed in the contract.
Maintenance, panel cleaning and fault handling after handover.
